title: Waymo Removes Driverless Taxis From US Freeways
excerpt: Waymo has removed its driverless taxis from all US freeways following a highway ban by California authorities after traffic incidents.
body_html:
Autonomous vehicle company Waymo has removed its driverless taxis from all freeways across the United States. The decision follows a recent ban implemented by California, which prohibited Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highway system.

The regulatory action by California officials came in the wake of a series of traffic incidents involving the autonomous fleet. Following the state-level prohibition, the company chose to withdraw its driverless taxi service from freeways nationwide.
